fusions.name: Barbed Lash
fusions.desc: Lashes a barbed tongue at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. It stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Tear the Barb Free
fusions.desc: Strikes with your weapon in a blow that deals 18 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, with 60% more damage for each one. The torn wound leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Snag and Haul
fusions.desc: Hooks a point up to 6 tiles away and hauls you there, and you cling on with 15% more dodge chance.

fusions.name: Lodged Barbs
fusions.desc: Every hit you land lodges a venomed barb in the target, up to 4. At 4 they all tear free at once, striking that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per barb. Unfed, a barb falls out every 4 seconds.
